presentation.label: DEJA VU
presentation.summary: Three new LFO waves with a loop of random values you can lock, mutate, snap to root and fifth, or glide.
presentation.overview: Deja Vu adds DJV, DJQ and DJC to the audio-track LFOs. Each keeps a loop of remembered random values: each visit to a slot replays its value or rolls a new one, DEJA (SPD) sets how often. The TRIG setting picks what moves through the loop: every step (FREE), a step-locked value per trig (HOLD), one slot per trig (ONE), or a trig that restarts it (TRIG, HALF). DJV steps, DJQ plays root, fifth and octaves on PTCH (whole knob steps elsewhere), DJC glides between values.
highlights: SPD sets DEJA (replay probability): p-lock it, put it on a scene, sweep it with the crossfader
MULT sets the loop length: 1, 2, 4 ... 64; in the step modes the track length gives any length up to 64
TRIG picks the clock: FREE every step, HOLD one value per step played by trigs, ONE one per trig, TRIG and HALF restart on a trig
DJQ: root, fifth and octaves on PTCH (DEP sets which are in reach), whole knob steps elsewhere; DJC: smooth glides
usage: LFO SETUP: WAVE = DJV, PMTR = PTCH, MULT = 64X, TRIG = HOLD, DEP up; then turn SPD from 0 (fresh) to 127 (locked)

limitations: Three waves (WAVE 19-21: DJV, DJQ, DJC); the WAVE cell's icon bound is raised to 21
Audio-track LFOs only; MIDI-track LFOs keep 19 waves
DJQ snaps PTCH to root, fifth and octaves (no scale setting); DJV and DJC move in 1/5-semitone knob steps
Opened without the module, an LFO on WAVE 19-21 plays SAW and the WAVE cell reads past stock's tables (not yet run on hardware)
First hardware use reported on one MKII over USB; not yet qualified

processing.label: CPU load
processing.display: 0.15-0.17 % of the ColdFire with all 24 LFOs on DJV, DJQ or DJC
processing.conditions: ot_emu coverage, all 24 audio-track LFOs on one wave, every track trigging every step, TRIG FREE (DJC also ONE); less than the same LFOs on stock RND

tests.summary: Host gate (verify.py) and 36 host tests; emulator: the five TRIG modes, DJQ root + fifth to 0.2 cents, DJC glides, trig kinds, ~0.15-0.17 % CPU with 24 LFOs. On one MKII over USB: loads and runs; behaviour reported by the developer, not yet measured.

access.location: LFO SETUP ([FUNC]+[LFO]): WAVE = DJV, DJQ or DJC
steps: Select a track, hold [FUNC] and press [LFO]
Turn B (WAVE) to DJV, DJQ or DJC, the last three waves
Set PMTR and DEP; SPD is DEJA, MULT the loop length, TRIG what moves through it
